packages.name: Divine Varanasi & Prayagraj
packages.description: Experience the spiritual heart of India with Ganga Aarti, Kashi Vishwanath Temple, and holy dips.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Varanasi, Evening Ganga Aarti
Day 2: Kashi Vishwanath, Sarnath, Local Temples
Day 3: Prayagraj Sangam, Hanuman Mandir
Day 4: Ayodhya Ram Mandir, Departure

packages.name: Royal Rajasthan Tour
packages.description: An 8-day trip from Prayagraj through Rajasthan's four royal cities — Jaipur the Pink City, Jodhpur the Blue City, Jaisalmer the Golden City and Udaipur the City of Lakes — with hill forts, palaces, a camel safari on the Sam sand dunes and a night at a desert camp.
highlights: Amber Fort, City Palace & Hawa Mahal, Jaipur
Camel safari & sunset at Sam Sand Dunes
Night at a desert camp with Rajasthani cultural programme
itinerary: Day 1: Prayagraj → Jaipur | Departure from Prayagraj for Jaipur | Arrival in Jaipur & hotel check-in | Evening at the local market | Overnight in Jaipur
Day 2: Jaipur sightseeing | Amber Fort | Jal Mahal | City Palace | Jantar Mantar | Hawa Mahal | Overnight in Jaipur
Day 3: Jaipur → Jodhpur | Morning departure | Arrival in Jodhpur & check-in | Mehrangarh Fort | Jaswant Thada | Clock Tower Market | Overnight in Jodhpur
Day 4: Jodhpur → Jaisalmer | Morning departure | Jaisalmer Fort | Patwon Ki Haveli | Gadisar Lake | Overnight in Jaisalmer
Day 5: Jaisalmer desert | Kuldhara Village | Sam Sand Dunes | Camel safari | Desert sunset | Rajasthani cultural programme & dinner | Overnight at Sam desert camp
Day 6: Jaisalmer → Udaipur | Early-morning departure | Arrival in Udaipur | Lake Pichola / Gangaur Ghat | Overnight in Udaipur
Day 7: Udaipur sightseeing | City Palace | Jagdish Temple | Saheliyon Ki Bari | Fateh Sagar Lake | Optional boat ride | Overnight in Udaipur
Day 8: Udaipur → Prayagraj | Breakfast & check-out | Return journey to Prayagraj
inclusions: All sightseeing & entry tickets (as per itinerary)
Desert camp stay with cultural programme & dinner
exclusions: Lunch, and dinners other than at the desert camp
Personal expenses (shopping, tips, laundry, phone calls)
Anything not listed under What's included

packages.name: Odisha Temples & Beaches Tour
packages.description: Discover the soul of Odisha in six days — temples, beaches, culture and nature: the ancient temples of Bhubaneswar, Lord Jagannath's Puri, the Sun Temple at Konark, the artists' village of Raghurajpur and a boat ride on Chilika Lake to spot dolphins.
highlights: Boat ride to the dolphin-spotting area, Chilika Lake
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Bhubaneswar | Bhubaneswar sightseeing: Lingaraj, Mukteshwar & Rajarani temples, Khandagiri & Udayagiri caves | Overnight in Bhubaneswar
Day 2: Bhubaneswar → Puri | Via Dhauli, Pipili & Raghurajpur | Jagannath Temple & Puri Beach | Overnight in Puri
Day 3: Chilika Lake / Satpada | Boat ride to the dolphin-spotting area | Return to Puri | Overnight in Puri
Day 4: Konark Sun Temple | Chandrabhaga Beach | Ramachandi | Return to Puri | Overnight in Puri
Day 5: Puri local sightseeing | Temples & local attractions | Evening transfer to Bhubaneswar | Overnight in Bhubaneswar
Day 6: Departure | Shopping / local sightseeing in Bhubaneswar | Drop at the airport / railway station
inclusions: Drop at Bhubaneswar airport / railway station
exclusions: Train / flight tickets to and from Bhubaneswar
Boat ride & entry tickets, unless confirmed with your booking
Personal expenses (shopping, tips, laundry, phone calls)

packages.name: Char Dham Yatra
packages.description: The sacred Char Dham Yatra covers all four holy abodes in Uttarakhand — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. A life-changing pilgrimage through the Himalayas. Every package is customised to your group.
itinerary: Day 1: Dehradun to Barkot — Pickup from Dehradun, drive via Mussoorie (subject to road conditions). Check-in and dinner. Overnight Barkot
Day 2: Yamunotri Darshan — Drive to Janki Chatti, trek ~5-6 km one way to Yamunotri Temple, return to Barkot. Overnight Barkot
Day 3: Barkot to Uttarkashi — Scenic drive through mountain region. Visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple if time permits. Overnight Uttarkashi
Day 4: Gangotri Darshan — Excursion to Gangotri Temple and return to Uttarkashi. Overnight Uttarkashi
Day 5: Uttarkashi to Guptkashi — Long mountain drive via Tehri and Rudraprayag. Rest after arrival. Overnight Guptkashi
Day 6: Kedarnath Yatra — Transfer to Gaurikund, trek ~16-18 km to Kedarnath. Overnight near temple (subject to availability). Overnight Kedarnath
Day 7: Kedarnath to Guptkashi — Morning darshan if possible, descend to Gaurikund, transfer back. Overnight Guptkashi
Day 8: Guptkashi to Badrinath — Drive via Joshimath, reach Badrinath for darshan. Overnight Badrinath
Day 9: Badrinath & Return — Morning darshan, Mana Village visit if accessible, drive towards Rudraprayag. Overnight Rudraprayag
Day 10: Rudraprayag to Rishikesh — Drive towards Rishikesh, short visit if time allows. Overnight Rishikesh
Day 11: Rishikesh to Dehradun — Breakfast and transfer to Dehradun airport/railway station/hotel. Departure

packages.name: Do Dham Yatra
packages.description: Visit the two most revered Dhams — Kedarnath and Badrinath — in one pilgrimage through the Garhwal Himalayas. Customised packages for all group sizes.
itinerary: Day 1: Dehradun/Haridwar to Guptkashi — Arrival and scenic drive. Overnight Guptkashi
Day 2: Kedarnath Yatra — Trek from Gaurikund to Kedarnath (~16-18 km). Overnight Kedarnath
Day 3: Kedarnath to Guptkashi — Morning darshan, descend and return. Overnight Guptkashi
Day 4: Guptkashi to Badrinath — Drive via Joshimath. Evening darshan. Overnight Badrinath
Day 5: Badrinath Darshan — Morning darshan, Mana Village. Drive to Rudraprayag. Overnight Rudraprayag
Day 6: Rudraprayag to Rishikesh — Visit Rishikesh attractions. Overnight Rishikesh
Day 7: Departure — Transfer to Dehradun/Haridwar for departure

packages.name: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra
packages.description: The ultimate spiritual pilgrimage to Mount Kailash and the sacred Mansarovar Lake in Tibet. A once-in-a-lifetime yatra that tests your endurance and deepens your faith. Fully customised packages with all permits and logistics handled.
itinerary: Day 1-2: Arrival Kathmandu — Acclimatization, Pashupatinath & Bouddhanath visit
Day 3: Kathmandu to Kerung — Cross Nepal-Tibet border. Overnight Kerung
Day 4-5: Kerung to Mansarovar — Drive through Tibetan plateau. Holy dip at Mansarovar Lake
Day 6-7: Mansarovar to Darchen — Transfer to base of Mount Kailash
Day 8-10: Kailash Parikrama — 3-day trek around Mount Kailash (52 km)
Day 11-12: Return to Kerung — Drive back via Saga
Day 13-14: Kerung to Kathmandu — Border crossing and return. Departure

packages.name: Jain Pilgrimage Tour
packages.description: A pilgrimage to India's most revered Jain Tirthas — from the magnificent Shatrunjaya Hill in Palitana to the exquisite Ranakpur and Dilwara temples. Customised for Jain families and groups with pure Jain meals.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Ahmedabad — Transfer to Palitana. Overnight Palitana
Day 2: Palitana — Shatrunjaya Hill climb (3,500+ steps), temple darshan. Overnight Palitana
Day 3: Palitana to Ranakpur — Visit Ranakpur Jain Temple (1,444 pillars). Overnight Ranakpur
Day 4: Ranakpur to Mount Abu — Dilwara Temple darshan. Overnight Mount Abu
Day 5: Mount Abu to Udaipur — Sightseeing if time permits. Overnight Udaipur
Day 6: Fly/Drive to next Tirtha as per itinerary. Overnight en route
Day 7: Temple visits and darshan. Overnight at destination
Day 8: Departure — Transfer to airport/station

packages.name: Dubai Tour Package
packages.description: Experience the glamour of Dubai — from the towering Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall to the golden desert safari and the charm of old Dubai souks. Includes Abu Dhabi city tour with Sheikh Zayed Mosque. Fully customised packages available.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Dubai — Airport pickup, hotel check-in, evening Dhow Cruise dinner. Overnight Dubai
Day 2: Dubai City Tour — Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai Frame, Old Dubai Souks, Jumeirah Beach. Overnight Dubai
Day 3: Desert Safari — Morning free, afternoon Desert Safari with dune bashing, camel ride, BBQ dinner, belly dance. Overnight Dubai
Day 4: Abu Dhabi Day Tour — Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Corniche, Emirates Palace photo stop. Return Dubai. Overnight Dubai
Day 5: Departure — Breakfast, free time for shopping, airport transfer

packages.name: Thailand Tour Package
packages.description: Discover the Land of Smiles — vibrant Bangkok temples, Pattaya beach life, and island hopping. From street food to floating markets, Thailand offers something for everyone. Customised itineraries available.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Bangkok — Airport pickup, hotel check-in. Evening free. Overnight Bangkok
Day 2: Bangkok City Tour — Grand Palace, Wat Phra Kaew, Wat Pho, Wat Arun. Overnight Bangkok
Day 3: Bangkok to Pattaya — Floating Market, Nong Nooch Garden. Overnight Pattaya
Day 4: Pattaya — Coral Island tour, water sports, Alcazar Show evening. Overnight Pattaya
Day 5: Pattaya to Bangkok — Safari World or shopping. Overnight Bangkok
Day 6: Departure — Breakfast, airport transfer

packages.name: Vietnam Tour Package
packages.destination: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ho Chi Minh City
packages.description: Explore the beauty of Vietnam — cruise through the stunning Ha Long Bay, walk the streets of historic Hanoi, and experience the energy of Ho Chi Minh City. Rich culture, amazing food, and breathtaking landscapes.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Hanoi — Airport pickup, Hoan Kiem Lake walk, Water Puppet Show. Overnight Hanoi
Day 2: Hanoi City Tour — Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Temple of Literature, Old Quarter. Overnight Hanoi
Day 3: Ha Long Bay — Drive to Ha Long, cruise through limestone karsts, kayaking. Overnight on cruise/hotel
Day 4: Ha Long to Hanoi — Morning cruise, return to Hanoi. Fly to Ho Chi Minh City. Overnight HCMC
Day 5: Ho Chi Minh City — Cu Chi Tunnels, War Remnants Museum, Ben Thanh Market. Overnight HCMC
Day 6: Departure — Breakfast, free time, airport transfer

packages.name: Srinagar Sonamarg Gulmarg Tour
packages.description: Discover the paradise of Kashmir — the City of Lakes Srinagar, the golden meadows of Sonamarg, and the stunning slopes of Gulmarg. Includes Mughal gardens, a houseboat night, and breathtaking Himalayan views. 2 nights Srinagar + 1 night Houseboat.
highlights: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh & Chashme Shahi
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Srinagar | Transfer to hotel | Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh & Chashme Shahi | Overnight in Srinagar
Day 2: Srinagar to Sonamarg excursion | Sindh Valley scenic drive | Thajiwas Glacier (optional pony ride) | Return to Srinagar | Overnight in Srinagar
Day 3: Srinagar to Gulmarg (60 km) | Explore Gulmarg meadows | Gondola ride (optional, payable separately) | Overnight in Houseboat
Day 4: Breakfast | Transfer to Srinagar Airport | Departure
inclusions: Hotel stay — 2 nights Srinagar + 1 night Houseboat
AC vehicle for all transfers & sightseeing
exclusions: Local union taxi charges & entry fees
packages.priceNote: Per person: 3★ Budget, group of 10. Rates vary by hotel category and group size.

packages.name: Kashmir Honeymoon Package
packages.description: A romantic escape through the paradise on Earth — Kashmir. Cruise on Dal Lake in a private Shikara, explore the flower-filled Mughal gardens, walk through Pahalgam's pine valleys, ride the Gulmarg Gondola with snow-capped peaks, and stay in a luxury houseboat under the stars. Perfect for couples and honeymooners.
highlights: Private Shikara Ride on Dal Lake
Mughal Gardens — Nishat, Shalimar, Chashme Shahi
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Srinagar | Airport pickup | Check-in at hotel | Evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake | Overnight in Srinagar
Day 2: Srinagar local sightseeing | Mughal Gardens — Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi | Shankaracharya Temple | Local market | Overnight in Srinagar
Day 3: Srinagar to Pahalgam (95 km) | Betaab Valley | Aru Valley | Chandanwari (optional) | Overnight in Pahalgam
Day 4: Pahalgam to Gulmarg (140 km) | Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 & 2 | Snow activities | Meadow walk | Overnight in Gulmarg
Day 5: Gulmarg to Srinagar via Sonamarg | Thajiwas Glacier view | Return to Srinagar | Houseboat check-in | Overnight in Houseboat
Day 6: Breakfast on Houseboat | Transfer to Srinagar Airport | Departure
inclusions: Deluxe hotel stay — 4 nights + 1 night Luxury Houseboat
AC vehicle for all transfers & sightseeing
Private Shikara ride on Dal Lake
exclusions: Candlelight dinner arrangement (available on request at extra cost)
packages.priceNote: Per person, couple package on double sharing

packages.name: Kashmir Honeymoon Escape — Srinagar, Sonamarg & Gulmarg
packages.description: A short, romantic Kashmir getaway for couples — the Mughal gardens of Srinagar, the golden meadows of Sonamarg, the mountain views of Gulmarg and a night together on a Kashmiri houseboat. 2 nights Srinagar + 1 night Houseboat.
highlights: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh & Chashme Shahi
Sonamarg — Meadow of Gold in the Sindh Valley
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Srinagar | Meet our representative & transfer to hotel | Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh & Chashme Shahi | Dinner & overnight in Srinagar
Day 2: Srinagar to Sonamarg excursion (approx. 100 km / 3 hrs) | Sindh Valley mountain views & meadows | Thajiwas Glacier (optional pony ride, payable) | Return for dinner & overnight in Srinagar
Day 3: Srinagar to Gulmarg (approx. 60 km / 2–3 hrs) | Explore Gulmarg | Gondola ride (optional, payable separately) | Overnight in Houseboat
Day 4: Breakfast | Transfer to Srinagar Airport | Departure
inclusions: 2 nights hotel in Srinagar + 1 night Houseboat
exclusions: Local union taxi charges & entry fees
packages.priceNote: Per person for a couple (2 Pax), 3★ Budget. Choose your hotel category when booking.

packages.name: Manali Honeymoon Package
packages.destination: Delhi, Manali, Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass
packages.description: A dreamy honeymoon in the lap of the Himalayas — snow-capped peaks, pine forests, and cosy nights in Manali. Explore the adventure playground of Solang Valley, drive up to Rohtang Pass (subject to permit), stroll through Old Manali's cafés and visit the ancient Hadimba Temple. Perfect for newlyweds seeking mountains and romance.
highlights: Rohtang Pass Excursion (subject to permit & weather)
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Delhi | Overnight Volvo bus to Manali (or flight to Kullu + transfer) | Overnight on bus / in transit
Day 2: Arrival in Manali | Hotel check-in & rest | Afternoon Hadimba Temple, Club House & Mall Road | Overnight in Manali
Day 3: Solang Valley day trip | Snow activities, zorbing, paragliding (seasonal, payable) | Atal Tunnel viewpoint | Overnight in Manali
Day 4: Rohtang Pass / Gulaba excursion (permit-dependent) | Afternoon visit Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali cafés | Overnight in Manali
Day 5: Breakfast & check-out | Departure to Delhi by Volvo / Kullu airport transfer
inclusions: Deluxe hotel / resort stay — 3 nights Manali
AC Volvo bus Delhi–Manali–Delhi (or Kullu airport transfers)
All local sightseeing by private vehicle
exclusions: Rohtang Pass permit fee (₹550/person, subject to availability)
Adventure activities at Solang (paragliding, zorbing, skiing — seasonal)
Anything not listed under What's included
packages.priceNote: Per person, couple package on double sharing

packages.name: Bali Tour Package
packages.description: Experience the Island of Gods — Bali's stunning temples, rice terraces, pristine beaches, and vibrant culture. From Ubud's spiritual heart to Kuta's beach vibes and Nusa Penida's dramatic cliffs. Fully customisable.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Bali — Airport pickup, hotel check-in, Kuta Beach sunset. Overnight Kuta/Seminyak
Day 2: Ubud Tour — Monkey Forest, Tegallalang Rice Terrace, Ubud Market, Bali Swing. Overnight Ubud
Day 3: Temples Tour — Tanah Lot Temple, Uluwatu Temple, Kecak Dance at sunset. Overnight Kuta
Day 4: Nusa Penida Day Trip — Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach. Overnight Kuta
Day 5: Water Sports & Free Day — Tanjung Benoa water sports, shopping. Overnight Kuta
Day 6: Departure — Breakfast, airport transfer

faqs.question: What is included in the tour package?
faqs.questionHi: टूर पैकेज में क्या शामिल है?
faqs.answer: All our packages include AC transport, hotel accommodation, meals (breakfast & dinner), guided tours, and entry tickets. Specific inclusions are listed on each package.
faqs.answerHi: हमारे सभी पैकेज में एसी ट्रांसपोर्ट, होटल आवास, भोजन (नाश्ता और रात का खाना), गाइडेड टूर और एंट्री टिकट शामिल हैं।

faqs.question: How do I book a tour?
faqs.answer: You can book through our website, call us at 6388360881, or message us on WhatsApp. We'll confirm your booking within 24 hours.
faqs.answerHi: आप हमारी वेबसाइट से बुक कर सकते हैं, 6388360881 पर कॉल करें, या WhatsApp पर मैसेज करें।

faqs.question: Is there a cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Yes, free cancellation up to 7 days before the trip. 50% refund for cancellations 3-7 days before. No refund for last-minute cancellations.
faqs.answerHi: हां, यात्रा से 7 दिन पहले तक मुफ्त कैंसिलेशन। 3-7 दिन पहले कैंसिलेशन पर 50% रिफंड।

faqs.question: Do you provide hotel accommodation?
faqs.questionHi: क्या आप होटल आवास प्रदान करते हैं?
faqs.answer: Yes, we partner with Hotel Ganga Imperial in Varanasi and quality hotels at all destinations. All stays are 3-star or above.
faqs.answerHi: हां, हम वाराणसी में होटल गंगा इम्पीरियल और सभी गंतव्यों पर गुणवत्ता वाले होटलों के साथ साझेदारी करते हैं।

faqs.question: Can I customise my tour package?
faqs.questionHi: क्या मैं अपना टूर पैकेज कस्टमाइज कर सकता हूं?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Contact us with your requirements and we'll create a custom itinerary that fits your budget and preferences.
faqs.answerHi: बिल्कुल! अपनी आवश्यकताओं के साथ हमसे संपर्क करें और हम आपके बजट के अनुसार कस्टम यात्रा कार्यक्रम बनाएंगे।
